entries.en: HEY! YOU OVER THERE! WHO SAID[n]YOU COULD STOP WORKING!?
IF YOU'RE NOT DOING YOUR JOBS, I'M[n]THE ONE WHO GETS CHEWED OUT BY[n]THE SECTION CHIEF, YOU KNOW!
I'M SICK OF HIM CALLING ME [clr 2]USELESS[clr 27]![n]GOT IT!?

entries.speaker: Humble Employee
entries.en: EEK! YES, CHIEF CLERK, SIR!

entries.speaker: Listless Employee
entries.en: HE'S GOT A POINT—THE SECTION CHIEF'S[n]CALLED ME [clr 2]NO GOOD[clr 27] A NUMBER OF[n]TIMES TOO... IT'S LIKE HIS CATCHPHRASE.

entries.speaker: Sleepy Employee
entries.en: THAT DOESN'T GIVE HIM THE RIGHT[n]TO TAKE IT OUT ON US EVERY TIME...

entries.speaker: Listless Employee
entries.en: WELL, CALLING ME [clr 2]USELESS[clr 27] ISN'T[n]GOING TO DO ANY GOOD.

entries.speaker: Listless Employee
entries.en: IF I WORK ANY HARDER THAN I ALREADY[n]AM, IT'LL BREAK ME. THEN I'LL REALLY BE[n]USELESS.

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: HM? WHO ARE YOU!?

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: BACK TO YOUR STATIONS! I'M THE[n]ONE WHO GETS CHEWED OUT BY[n]THE SECTION CHIEF, YOU KNOW!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, we don't even work here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Skull, would you mind staying focused[n]on what we came here for?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Excuse me, we're here to see the chief[n]director—we have something we need[n]to discuss with him, so...

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: YOU? SEEING THE CHIEF DIRECTOR?

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: AS IF SOME NOBODIES LIKE YOURSELVES[n]HAVE ANY BUSINESS WHATSOEVER[n]WITH SOMEONE SO IMPORTANT!

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: NOW, GET BACK TO YOUR STATIONS[n]BEFORE I MAKE YOU GO!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, it was worth a try.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Get ready, everyone!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh. I'm thinkin' we can tell whether[n]they're the target if we can [clr 2]squeeze[clr 27][n][clr 2]some info outta 'em[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, we ended up fightin' anyways, but I[n]think this is prolly a good way of doin' this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can prolly tell whether they're the[n]target if we can [clr 2]squeeze some info outta[clr 27][n][clr 2]'em[clr 27] before we fight.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's right! We might be able to avoid[n]unnecessary battles if we [clr 2]cross-reference[clr 27][n][clr 2]that information[clr 27]!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Phew, we're done with that.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It doesn't look like he had anything,[n]unfortunately. It seems he wasn't[n]important, after all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh well... Let's check elsewhere.
[clr 2]AHEM![clr 27] WHO MAY YOU BE?
The Phantom Thieves.
Passersby.
We want to talk.
WH-WHAT!? THIS IS TERRIBLE! I[n]MUST CALL SECURITY AT ONCE!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Uh-oh, it'll be a problem if he reports us...[n]Let's silence him!
YOU ARE SIMPLY PASSING BY A[n]PLACE LIKE THIS? THAT SOUNDS[n]RATHER SUSPICIOUS INDEED.
ALTHOUGH... I USED TO GET INTO[n]SOME RECKLESS SITUATIONS [clr 2]WHEN[clr 27][n][clr 2]I WAS YOUNG[clr 27] MYSELF.
NOW THEN, WHAT BUSINESS DO[n]YOU HAVE WITH ME?
YOU HAVE BUSINESS WITH ME? BUT[n]TO THE EXTENT OF MY KNOWLEDGE,[n]THIS IS OUR FIRST MEETING.
WELL THEN, WHAT DO YOU NEED?
What is your rank?
Where's the chief director?
Nothing in particular.
MY RANK? YOU COULD SAY I'M[n]SOMEWHERE IN THE UPPER ECHELONS.
WHY DO YOU ASK?
...THE CHIEF DIRECTOR? WHAT[n]DO YOU NEED WITH HIM?
HE IS QUITE BUSY MAKING SURE[n]THIS CORPORATION REMAINS THE[n][clr 2]BEST OF THE BEST[clr 27].
AH, SO YOU WANT NOTHING FROM[n]ME THEN. IN THAT CASE, I MUST[n]ASK YOU TO LEAVE NOW.
THERE IS LITTLE TIME FOR SLACKING.[n]I MUST ENSURE THIS COMPANY IS[n]THE [clr 2]BEST OF THE BEST[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It is time we make our decision, Joker.[n]What do you want to do?
Let's fight him.
We should leave.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Right, there's no need for any more[n]discussion. Take him down!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So you don't want to fight right now?[n]Then let's retreat!
ARE YOU LEAVING? IN THAT CASE,[n]I SHALL RETURN TO MY WORK.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Serves you right, bastard! That takes care of that!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This guy's got nothing on him though.[n]1000% waste of time.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I-It seems their physical size doesn't[n]necessarily correlate to their rank...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The chief director must be somewhere[n]else... Let's try looking in another room.
